title: YAPS
tagline: Decentralized prediction market that leverages oracles to create and resolve bets
description: This project improves upon existing prediction markets, which are permissioned, limited and complex, and introduces a new prediction marketplace that leverages oracles and automated API's to resolve bets. This allows users to create arbitrary bets as long as there is an oracle that can be used to resolve it.
how_its_made: This project uses @Dune and @Covalent as data sources to resolve bets, and I was planning to try to integrate on-chain oracles as well. I will try to add support for @Worldcoin, @ENS and @Lens, and I plan to deploy to @Optimism, @Polygon, and @Skale blockchains. If time permits, I would like to add @XMTP for social features.
